Subject: Scheduling: Technical screens for Samuel Park (SWE - ML infra)

Hi team,

We're moving Samuel Park (applied for SWE - ML infra) into the technical screen stage and would like to book two back-to-back sessions: a 60-minute coding exercise (live CoderPad) and a 45-minute ML systems/design discussion. Samuel is in EST (UTC-4).

Here are candidate-available slots in PST:
- Wed 9/15: 10:00–11:00
- Thu 9/16: 14:00–15:00
- Fri 9/17: 09:00–10:00

Preferred plan: Markus to lead the coding segment; Aditya to lead the ML systems discussion. Dev, can you be backup proctor for the coding pad in case of access help? Soojin, can you confirm interviewer availability and whether we should make the two sessions contiguous or separated by a short buffer?

Attachments: Samuel_Park_Resume.pdf (see summary page 2 for ML infra work)

Links: Candidate profile: https://hub.company/recruiting/candidates/PRJ-8341 — Calendar placeholders will be created once we lock a slot. We also have an internal ML sandbox we can pre-provision: https://internal-sandbox.redwood.ai/ml-session/2026-09-16-ml-park

Quick asks:
- Confirm availability (who can do coding and who can do systems)
- Confirm whether you want the sessions back-to-back (I can put a 15-minute buffer if preferred)
- Markus/Aditya: any special tooling or repo links we should give the candidate ahead of time?

Thanks — I want to lock this by EOD today so recruiting can send the invites.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — I can take this.

My preferences:
- Let's book Thu 9/16. Candidate slots work better for our team.
- Please split into two contiguous blocks with a 15-minute buffer: 14:00–15:00 (coding, Markus lead) and 15:15–16:00 (ML systems, Aditya lead). That gives a little breathing room.
- Dev, please be the backup for CoderPad (help with any access issues) — appreciate it.

One note: Markus and Aditya are in PST; candidate is EST so the times above are 17:00–18:00 EST for the candidate. I'll confirm with them when I get the calendar placeholder.

Laura — can you ask Samuel to share his GitHub handle and the primary email he wants used for the CoderPad invite? Also, please attach a short tech brief (one-pager) for the interviewers with scoring rubric — that'll help standardize feedback.

Thanks — Soojin
